question: Choose a goalkeeper action using estimate.horizontalRange and estimate.heightRange, which are rough future goal-line ranges in metres inferred from 160 ms of observed flight. The real target is hidden. Curl can make the estimate wrong. Do NOT defend the ball's current position in the samples: it is still far from goal. Compare the ESTIMATED RANGE with the zones described below and choose the best coverage. Positive x means RIGHT on screen, negative x LEFT. Leave the ball only if the estimated range mostly misses the goal.

criteria.left_low: Defend left low: estimated horizontalRange is negative x, between -3.66 and -1.1 metres; estimated heightRange is height between 0 and 1.22 metres.
criteria.left_high: Defend left high: estimated horizontalRange is negative x, between -3.66 and -1.1 metres; estimated heightRange is height between 1.22 and 2.44 metres.
criteria.center_low: Defend center low: estimated horizontalRange is x near zero, between -1.1 and +1.1 metres; estimated heightRange is height between 0 and 1.22 metres.
criteria.center_high: Defend center high: estimated horizontalRange is x near zero, between -1.1 and +1.1 metres; estimated heightRange is height between 1.22 and 2.44 metres.
criteria.right_low: Defend right low: estimated horizontalRange is positive x, between +1.1 and +3.66 metres; estimated heightRange is height between 0 and 1.22 metres.
criteria.right_high: Defend right high: estimated horizontalRange is positive x, between +1.1 and +3.66 metres; estimated heightRange is height between 1.22 and 2.44 metres.
criteria.leave_wide: Stay upright when the estimated range mostly falls outside x=-3.66 to +3.66 metres or height=0 to 2.44 metres. The estimate can be wrong.

shootQuestion: You are Jev, taking a penalty against a human goalkeeper. Choose one target to score. You can see ONLY completed turns in history. Look for areas the goalkeeper leaves uncovered. With no history, choose a corner. The human has not moved for this turn: never claim to know their current position. Directions are from the shooter viewpoint, the same left and right as the screen. Return one attacking target.

shootCriteria.left_low: Shoot low left. Target x=-0.62, y=0.25. Favor this target when completed goalkeeper movements leave it uncovered.
shootCriteria.left_high: Shoot high left. Target x=-0.62, y=0.76. Favor this target when completed goalkeeper movements leave it uncovered.
shootCriteria.center_low: Shoot low center. Target x=0, y=0.25. Favor this target when completed goalkeeper movements leave it uncovered.
shootCriteria.center_high: Shoot high center. Target x=0, y=0.76. Favor this target when completed goalkeeper movements leave it uncovered.
shootCriteria.right_low: Shoot low right. Target x=0.62, y=0.25. Favor this target when completed goalkeeper movements leave it uncovered.
shootCriteria.right_high: Shoot high right. Target x=0.62, y=0.76. Favor this target when completed goalkeeper movements leave it uncovered.
